Google still showed impressions for historical .html and legacy intelligence/profile URLs. The 22 September measurement-cleanup wave creates lightweight canonical move pages for the measured historical URLs. They point visitors and crawlers to the current maintained routes without adding the aliases to the sitemap.

## Evaluation rules
Do not call the new tools successful or unsuccessful until settled search and engagement data exists. Review:
1. organic impressions,
2. tool starts,
3. tool completions,
4. result/report downloads,
5. shares,
6. profile opens,
7. repeat usage,
8. organic search clicks,
9. resource downloads,
10. relevant search-query expansion.

The first useful comparison should use a post-launch settled period rather than mixing pre-launch and post-launch dates.
